paragraphs: Rav Acha bar Rav Huna studied Shevuot at Rabbah’s academy (see Ifa); Rav Shmuel son of Rabbah bar bar Chana and Rav Yitzchak son of Rabbi Yehudah also studied Shevuot there. Rav Kahana met them, etc.; Rava bar Ittai told them, Shevuot 36, end of b, 37a. Rav Safra, Rav Huna bar Chinena, and Abaye, Bava Batra 167b; Shabbat 124a. He asked Rav Sheshet, Bava Batra 70, beginning of a; Rav Sheshet waves his hand, Sanhedrin 43a. In Rav Sheshet’s name: Berakhot 23a, 32a; Eruvin 20b. He sent it before Rav Yosef, Kiddushin 12b. He spoke to Rav Nachman, Chullin 76b. Rava called him a great man, Nedarim 90a; Rav Chisda likewise, and sent through him to Rabbah, Pesachim 47a; Yevamot 29b. He objected to Rava, Menachot 16a; asked him, Kiddushin 6b; raised a contradiction to him, Shabbat 150a. Rava sent him and Rav Safra to have the sacrifice offered at a private altar sent by Ifra Hormiz, King Shapur’s mother, Zevachim 116b. Rosh Hashanah 30b: Rav Acha bar Huna should read Rav Acha bar Rav Huna. Rava, his son.
